title: Lists everyone uses
sub: The same one, everywhere, a series on master and reference data: airport codes that outlive their reasons; the lists that sort Linh at the university, each system with its own names, and a list of statuses typed again by hand; reference data, the university's own and from outside; one home for each list, with its owner and the date each value applies from; tests that read the list instead of typing it; a change made as a pull request its owner approves; countries from the international standard; lists about people kept short; and the same lists in a bank and a hospital.
howto: The film is drawn in watercolour. Each role has its own colour: student teal, applicant amber, tutor violet, researcher coral, alumna green. A list is a paper card with a yellow tab, its codes in type and its labels in words. Cyan edges the technical side, gold the business side.
